blocker.classification: 测试缺陷 (pre-existing test defect), NOT a migration regression and NOT an environment problem
evidence: baseline-guard.log: the identical panic at the pristine start SHA 2b1e132 with exit 1, i.e. before any T07 file existed (T07/pristine/baseline-guard.exit = 1)
git log -1 --format=%h app/admin/service/internal/data/ent/schema/access_key.go: field.String("secret_ciphertext").NotEmpty().Sensitive() was introduced by commit 0c8e567
git log --oneline app/admin/service/internal/data/ent/tenant_guard_test.go: dates to 10a7256 first commit, so the fixture predates the required field and was never updated
The two seed rows tenant_guard_test.go:148 and :150 call AccessKey.Create().SetAccessKey(...).SetName(...) with no SetSecretCiphertext, so CreateX panics on the NotEmpty validator
Consequence: the assertion the test exists to pin (cross-tenant Update/Delete must hit 0 rows) is never reached, so this run produced no positive evidence for the access_key write guard
blocker.why_not_fixed_here: The user's continuation authorization for the earlier T02 defect was explicitly scoped: 本授权不扩展为自动修复其他未知上游缺陷；新的测试问题先区分来源、环境、测试缺陷和迁移回归，按总goal处理. Editing the fixture would be a new test change outside T07's approved file set (T07.md 业务Repository方法只改import / 不扩展身份授权租户), and silently repairing it would hide a real repo defect from the reviewer.
blocker.minimal_unblock_ask: One test-only patch, analogous in kind to the approved T02-B1: add SetSecretCiphertext("GUARD_T1_CIPHERTEXT") / SetSecretCiphertext("GUARD_T2_CIPHERTEXT") (any non-empty placeholder; the field is Sensitive() and never asserted on) to the two seed rows in tenant_guard_test.go, keeping every assertion, the required-tests entry and the equiv/guard gates unchanged. With that change the test is expected to exercise the guard as written; this run did not verify that prediction.
